0.0: I see you have tried the sailings! You are ready for mission now, yes?
0.1: Now that you are worthy of seafaring, I will tell you about Frostwitch, troubler of my people. Once, all was well. Now, seawater floods the towns, glaciers turn to water. This is no doubt the work of #r#p1510008##k!
0.2: #fNpc/1510008.img/unknown/0#\r\n#r#p1510008##k is witch most horrendous! I am told she takes many children from penguins, seals, AND malamutes to make her stew.
0.3: #fNpc/1510008.img/unknown/0#\r\nI have many eyes in waters. They have told me, this #r#p1510008##k, she appears at all sites of glacier problems. The evil witch will drown us all. She must be crushed like ice is crushed for frothy drinks!
0.4: There are three of Ice Stations in Riena Strait. You will visit #b#m141010000##k and see if there's anything you can do of help, yes? Go to north.

yes.0: Do not give up until the witch is gone!\r\n#e#b(Traverse the Riena Strait to #m141010000#.)#k\r\n

no.0: Let me know when you want to go. Gooo team!

1.2: Waaaaait a minute. I don't know you! You're not a penguin!

yes.0: Well I'll be a monkeyface prickleback! You must be that hero everybody's gushing about. These peepers couldn't pick you out until you got nice and close.
